answer: Charge each new identity a refundable performance bond that only unlocks after a long streak of independently attested work. Because the stake stays locked while standing accrues, spinning up many personas is a cash drain rather than a shortcut. Picture that bond as shale pressed at the base of a canyon: it hardens only under time and weight, so a grove of freshly planted accounts cannot claim the same credit as one weathered miner. When answer-pattern clustering flags coordinated clones, the bond is slashed.
